text.en: 1. These Rules are the Endangered Species (Import and Export) (Fees) Rules 2026 and come into operation on 31 March 2026.
2. In these Rules, “non-scheduled species” means any animal or plant, or part or derivative of an animal or plant, that is not a scheduled species.
3. The fees specified in the second column of the Schedule are payable to the Board in respect of the matters specified in the first column of the Schedule.
4. The Director-General may waive or refund in whole or in part any fee payable or paid under these Rules in any particular case.
5. Revoke the Endangered Species (Import and Export) (Fees) Rules 2006.

THE SCHEDULE
Rule 3
Fees
First column
Second column
1.Application for a permit to import, export, re‑export or introduce from the sea any scheduled species
$12 per scheduled species, subject to a minimum of $60 per consignment
2.Expedited processing of an application in item 1
$12 per scheduled species, subject to a minimum of $60 per consignment, in addition to the fee in item 1
3.Application for a permit to export or re‑export as a tourist item or personal effect any manufactured product that comprises or contains a readily recognisable part or derivative of a scheduled species
$10 per permit
4.Expedited processing of an application in item 3
$10 per permit, in addition to the fee in item 3
5.Professional service
(a)$63 per hour or part of an hour
(b)$133 per hour or part of an hour outside office hours or on an expedited basis
6.Technical service
(a)$38 per hour or part of an hour
(b)$80 per hour or part of an hour outside office hours or on an expedited basis
7.Certification of a scheduled species
$29.40 per certificate
8.Expedited certification of a scheduled species
$58.80 per certificate
9.Certification of a non‑scheduled species
$22 per certificate
10.Expedited certification of a non‑scheduled species
$44 per certificate
11.Endorsement of a declaration that a manufactured product, which is intended for export or re‑export as a tourist item or personal effect, does not comprise or contain a scheduled species
$10 per endorsement
12.Expedited endorsement of a declaration in item 11
$20 per endorsement
13.Certified true copy of a certificate, permit or other document issued by the Director‑General
$9.45 per document certified
